description: Read the buyer's own Cyclesite message threads and any seller replies. With no arguments it lists the buyer's conversations; with a threadId it returns that thread's messages. Enquiries the buyer has sent to sellers appear here. Requires OAuth scope `listings:read`. Example: 'did the seller of that Trek reply yet?'.

threadId.description: Thread id from a conversation list or a sent enquiry. Omit to list all threads.

name: get_my_messages
title: My messages
